title: Share localhost pages for every framework
items: A new page, /share, explains whk share: install and first run, what your dev server sees through the link, what each plan allows, reserved names and passwords, and how it differs from whk tunnel --live

Fourteen framework guides under /share: Next.js, Vite, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Angular, Express, webpack-dev-server, Rails, Laravel, Django, Flask, FastAPI and Phoenix, each with its default port, the setting it needs behind a public link (or why it needs none), the error that setting prevents, and whether hot reload comes through
The Share localhost docs list every framework with its command and the one thing to know, and the CLI docs link to the guides
